side_missions.title: Old Friends, New Stars
side_missions.description: Sensors have picked up a damaged escape pod drifting near the Asteroid Belt. The transponder code is old — very old. It belongs to Nine Lives, a legendary survivor and one of Aristotle's oldest friends from the streets.

objectives.description: Locate the damaged escape pod in the Asteroid Belt

side_missions.title: Last Cat Standing
side_missions.description: Reports of a lone cat holding a besieged outpost against League forces have reached your ears. No Tail — scarred, tail-less, and furious — won't join just anyone. She respects only strength.

objectives.description: Prove your strength to No Tail
Convince No Tail to join your crew

side_missions.title: The Labyrinth Navigator
side_missions.description: Strange signals emanate from deep within a fairy-realm labyrinth. Someone is trapped inside — someone who already knows you're coming. Silky, the enigmatic cartographer, has been waiting.

objectives.description: Meet Silky and welcome her aboard

side_missions.title: The Surgeon's Price
side_missions.description: A war zone field hospital is about to be overrun. Blood Paw, a former Lion court physician who defected, is the only thing keeping dozens of wounded alive. She won't leave until everyone is safe.

objectives.description: Locate the field hospital in the war zone
Convince Blood Paw to join your crew
